faq.question: Is it free?
faq.answer: Yes. The Free plan is free forever. Premium and Pro prices are placeholders until payments are available.

faq.question: Can I cancel anytime?
faq.answer: You can change your selected plan at any time. There are no recurring charges in this demo.

faq.question: How do herders get paid?
faq.answer: The platform connects guests and buyers directly with herder families. Payment processing is not enabled yet, so arrangements are made directly.

faq.question: Is my personal info safe?
faq.answer: This demo stores account data in your browser's localStorage and does not send it to a server. Avoid using real or sensitive information.
